steps: Confirm you are an Iowa resident (the offer is Iowa-only).

Go to https://open.crbt.bank (via the 'Open a checking account' button at http://crbt.bank/bonus) and open a new consumer checking account ($25 minimum opening deposit; BankOn Checking is not eligible).
Within 90 calendar days of account opening: post at least 15 qualifying Visa debit card point-of-sale transactions (ATM transactions do not qualify).
Within the same 90 days: receive an aggregate of $500 in qualifying direct deposits (person-to-person transfers may not qualify).
Keep the account open for a minimum of 90 days with a positive balance.
The $425 bonus (accounts opened online default to the $425 cash credit rather than a gift) is paid within 30 days after the end of the 90-day qualifying period.
